  • Method Details

    • publicationSyncsOnlyChangedClientPolicy

      public static void publicationSyncsOnlyChangedClientPolicy(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper) throws ReflectiveOperationException
      To reproduce in-game: change pile height or the exact-item deny list, then change a stack enable flag or a gallery/mod-deny namespace. Only the latter changes synchronize client policy. Repeating /ss reload with unchanged values sends no policy packet. The callback counts here distinguish an absent update from an update whose contents look unchanged.
      Throws:
      ReflectiveOperationException

    • admissionSeparatesPlayersAutomationAndTypes

      public static void admissionSeparatesPlayersAutomationAndTypes(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)
      To reproduce in-game: deny minecraft:stone by item id; players cannot deposit it, but hoppers can. Deny the minecraft mod and both paths refuse it. Existing contents remain extractable. Bar-tagged items go to Bar and Storage, never Singles, including when the exact-item deny list excludes them only for players. This fixture also checks empty inputs for every type.

    • namespacePolicyIsPreparedAndBounded

      public static void namespacePolicyIsPreparedAndBounded(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: put mixed-case, duplicate, and malformed namespaces in gen_mods and disable_mods, then reload and inspect both lists. Valid names are lowercased and unique. Reload a list containing 257 distinct names or a valid 257-character name: the previous complete policy stays active. Adding a 257th namespace by command fails without saving it.

    • policyPacketsValidateBeforePublication

      public static void policyPacketsValidateBeforePublication(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: disable Storage and Bar, enable Singles, and reload; mode cycling skips the disabled types while /ss write list uses the new gallery list. Reconnect to a server with different lists and enable flags to see the whole snapshot replaced. This fixture also injects malformed wire data and checks the maximum legal payload, which ordinary UI cannot send.
